correctness.rationale: For two distinct positive queries the surviving centers are either a subset of a coordinate line of size q-2, two centers, or empty. A third query can divide those survivors only with a branch of size at most one, excluding a further depth-two tree and thereby every depth-four full tree. Complete and independently replayed trees achieve depth three in H(2,3) and H(4,2), depth two in H(3,2); elementary positive-branch bounds handle the smaller cases. Hamming-induced embeddings propagate all lower bounds. The VC comparison quotes the exact established Theorem 4.7 and independently checks small regimes. No extrapolation from finite enumeration is used.

value.rationale: The all-parameter exact adaptive rank and its sharp stabilization at three give a complete online-complexity invariant for a canonical distance-transitive graph family. H(2,3) is the unique full Hamming graph with different VC and Littlestone ranks, showing a genuine structural adaptive gap in the minimal ternary rook graph. The uniform bound transfers to every induced subgraph. This is neither just a numerical improvement nor a relabeling of the previously known static VC classification.
